scenarios.name: Base install and boot
scenarios.expected_behavior: Fresh integrated ISO installs plain/LUKS2 Btrfs, then two UEFI disk-only boots and installed-smoke.sh pass

scenarios.name: Gaming packages
scenarios.expected_behavior: Signed package resolution succeeds, pacman -Dk is coherent; package presence alone establishes no runtime result

scenarios.name: Native Vulkan loader and ICD
scenarios.expected_behavior: Valid ICD manifests, architecture-compatible loader libraries and real vulkaninfo enumeration with exact device/driver observations

scenarios.name: Vulkan execution
scenarios.expected_behavior: 64-bit queue submission clears an image, fence completes and 256 pixels match; record renderer/ICD, software status and separately qualify WSI

scenarios.name: 32-bit Vulkan
scenarios.expected_behavior: lib32 dependency checks plus ELF32 loader/ICD execution and verified readback; missing runtime remains UNVERIFIED even if packages pass

scenarios.name: Steam runtime and session
scenarios.expected_behavior: Dependencies and runtime diagnosed, unprivileged Wayland/XWayland launch inspected, process lifetime/exit/logs captured; stop at login boundary

scenarios.name: Proton Win32 smoke
scenarios.expected_behavior: Explicit Steam Linux Runtime starts inspected Proton; checksum-pinned own Win32 fixture creates a window and returns a fresh nonce with exit zero

scenarios.name: Gamescope nested launch
scenarios.expected_behavior: Nested gamescope starts bounded vkcube presentation or documents unsupported virtual-device prerequisites and exact launch diagnostics

scenarios.name: MangoHud and GameMode
scenarios.expected_behavior: Wrapper workloads run, visible overlay is independently inspected, daemon readiness/test/invocation and restoration pass; no FPS benefit claim

scenarios.name: Gaming readiness CLI JSON
scenarios.expected_behavior: Real production interface returns parseable JSON matching actual driver/runtime limitations, without claiming physical GPU qualification

scenarios.name: Controlled negatives
scenarios.expected_behavior: Missing/corrupt ICD, wrong ELF architecture, missing lib32 ICD, no device, unknown vendor, absent Steam/Proton, unsupported gamescope, dependency mismatch, transaction refusal and invalid preset yield actionable diagnostics without crashes or false readiness

scenarios.name: Encrypted gaming setup
scenarios.expected_behavior: Signed feature setup through authorized product transaction in disposable LUKS2 installation, user-session smoke and disk-only reboot preserve encryption

scenarios.name: Signed update and rollback
scenarios.expected_behavior: Existing Phase 3 H/I/J/K/M plus Phase 2 payload/space/package/health/service/interruption regressions pass after gaming integration; known-good pairs, histories, snapshots, recovery and direct-package guard preserved

scenarios.name: Enforcing Secure Boot
scenarios.expected_behavior: Existing trusted boot and unsigned/untrusted/tampered loader/UKI tests refuse exact integrated bytes with authentication evidence; native UKI signing retained

scenarios.name: Independent ISO bytes
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only after production merges, two clean signed builds have identical complete ISO bytes, package manifests and hashes

scenarios.name: Physical GPU qualification
scenarios.expected_behavior: Actual NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/hybrid hardware supplies driver, Vulkan64/32, display, controller and recovery evidence; virtual/software runs cannot pass
